Product overview

Electric wine openers are the anchor item of every gifting and retail bar programme: four-cell AA or USB-rechargeable format, foil cutter and vacuum stopper configurations, and colour-box packaging that is proven on retail shelves. The range below is produced on our own tooling, so motor torque, battery format and finish stay consistent between orders.

Rechargeable Wine Opener and Dispenser Kit S/5 (model SGS-KD-7-P) is moulded in Stainless steel + ABS. Opener plus electric wine dispenser, 5-piece kit. Unit weight is — and it is packed 25 sets / 64x36x25 cm / 14 kg, so you can plan freight per carton rather than per unit.

Because the tooling is ours, motor quality, finish and box counts stay consistent between orders — the single most common complaint buyers raise about sourcing from trading companies. Every run is checked against the approved pre-production sample before it is packed.

This item can be produced in your own colour and decorated with your logo, event name or a client's brand. Retail-ready colour boxes, hang tags and UPC barcodes are available for retail and e-commerce programmes. Add it to a mixed order and we will consolidate it with the rest of your items so it ships as one entry.

How to order this item

Add the Rechargeable Wine Opener and Dispenser Kit S/5 to your quote list with the quantity you need, or send us the model number directly. We return a quotation that sets out the unit price for your specification, decoration cost, packaging cost and dispatch time, followed by a virtual proof and — where the finish is colour sensitive — a physical pre-production sample for approval. OEM and ODM briefs are welcome: send a drawing, a reference sample or a target cost.

What is the production lead time?

Standard FOB dispatch is 10-15 days for small batch production after sample approval, excluding shipping time to your destination. Peak season and full-container programmes are planned per order — the confirmed date is stated on the quotation and proforma invoice.

Is the material food contact safe?

The Rechargeable Wine Opener and Dispenser Kit S/5 is moulded in Stainless steel + ABS. The food-contact test report and safety data sheet for the recorded material grade are provided with the quotation so your compliance team can file them for your market.

Is the wine opener battery powered or rechargeable?

It depends on the model: USB-rechargeable versions charge over the included cable, while battery versions are supplied without batteries so you can localise the battery type for your market. The power format for each SKU is stated on the specification table and confirmed on the quotation.
